description: AMX displayed in the garden square in front of the DECEA (Departamento de Controle do Espaço Aéreo) building at Santos Dumont airport; seen 4 Nov 2024 (AeroEntusiasta). A forum report of 2021 of an AMX 'in front of III COMAR at SDU' is almost certainly the same airframe.
